mechanicalFields.mechanicalCheck: The provider authors educational subquestion wording once; Revision validates the structured item without asking the provider to reproduce the same wording in a second top-level representation.
Revision composes top-level questionWording from validated subquestions[].wording in governed order with a stable blank-line separator, preserving every subquestion wording verbatim.

Revision derives duplicated subquestion requirementIds from validated coverageEvidence requirement identifiers; the provider authors the educational coverage evidence rather than a second clerical identifier list.

supersededBaseInventoryStatements.fieldClass: subquestion wording presence in rendered question
supersededBaseInventoryStatements.reason: The post-Pilot #20 inventory treated exact agreement between two provider-authored wording representations as a fail-closed validation concern. Pilot #21 proved the duplicate representation itself was the generic defect.
Top-level questionWording is no longer generative judgement. Educational subquestions[].wording and original context remain generative judgement.
